title: Sign Search
description: Sign Search is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you search for signs in the world by text.
body:
## Simple to use Sign Search mod --- **SignSearch is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that lets you search for signs in the world by text. Making searching for specific signs faster and more efficient.**
Simply type /signsearch in chat, and any loaded signs containing your search term will be highlighted with a neon green glow.
### Features: - 🔍 Search signs by text - 💚 Green highlight overlay - ✅ 100% client-sided
### Commands: ` /signsearch ` — highlight all signs containing the searched-for text (not case or space sensitive) ` /signsearch (without text) ` — clear the current search, removing the glow effect from signs
